provider: AHN, the Dutch water authorities, provinces and Rijkswaterstaat
dataset: AHN5 classified-ground DTM, bounded numeric scenery export with explicitly classified mapped-water/ground-gap fills
horizontal_crs: Original source EPSG:28992, retained grid in unchanged local source east/north metres
vertical_datum: AHN5 NAP heights minus exactly the same filtered road minimum as elevation-corrections.json. No additional vertical scaling or median rebase.
attribution: Bron: AHN(www.ahn.nl), AHN5 DTM via official AHN dataroom-linked WCS. Modified by bounded numeric export, bilinear local-grid sampling and labelled estimates for water/NoData holes. Water geometry©OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL1.0.
method: Preserve the previous scenery lattice and20m near-road join. Valid AHN5 numeric ground is measured input. Water planes come from actual mapped coast/pond polygons; they are not lidar returns. Remaining small gaps under buildings/scrub use bounded inverse-distance support, never a roof DSM or unconstrained plane. RoadXYZ, width and banking are not modified.
grid_frame_note: Retained grid XY uses this original geographic projection scale. Materialization composes current provenance scene scale into XY origin/spacing only; source heights and vertical datum remain unchanged.
